subject.title: Choose the scope for fictional issue candidate 125

question: How should the fictional issue candidate scope be handled?

why.summary: The candidate requires an explicit human scope decision.
reasons: Automation must not choose product scope on behalf of a maintainer.

evidence.summary: The sanitized candidate proposes a new public workflow.

how.summary: Return the typed answer to the guarded planning pass.
expectedEffects: Approve, revise, or skip only the recorded candidate.
verification: Revalidate the candidate identifier and clean worktree before planning.

options.title: Approve scope
options.description: Continue planning the recorded fictional scope.
consequences: The next guarded planning pass may consume the candidate.

options.title: Revise scope
options.description: Keep automation stopped until a revised candidate exists.
consequences: A new candidate and decision context will be required.
options.recommendationReason: The fictional scope needs clearer acceptance criteria.

options.title: Skip candidate
options.description: Do not continue this fictional candidate.
consequences: No issue is created from this candidate.
